backup.production_rule: One new table (RLS on, staff read policy, service_role writes) and one new service_role function. Nothing existing is altered and the release writes no row. The backup is taken as the LAST act before the apply (D-210).

forward_verification.name: the_table_exists_with_rls
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_class where oid = 'public.client_errors'::regclass and relrowsecurity)

forward_verification.name: the_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = 'a342e73072f9b02c73da3ec03a82925b' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.record_client_error_v1(text, text, text, text, jsonb, boolean)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: service_role_only_writes
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.record_client_error_v1(text, text, text, text, jsonb, boolean)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.record_client_error_v1(text, text, text, text, jsonb, boolean)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.record_client_error_v1(text, text, text, text, jsonb, boolean)','EXECUTE') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.client_errors','SELECT') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.client_errors','INSERT') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.client_errors','INSERT')

forward_verification.name: staff_read_policy_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_policy where polrelid = 'public.client_errors'::regclass and polname = 'client_errors_staff_read')
